meta_description: Alex Painter & Decorator in Leeds offers interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering. Free quotes. Reliable local service.
hero_eyebrow: Trusted Painter & Decorator — Over 15 Years in Leeds
hero_subhead: Professional interior and exterior painting in Leeds. Free quote within 24 hours, no obligation.
services_subhead: From interior walls to exterior cladding, we handle every painting and decorating job with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: We transform living spaces with high-quality interior paint. Whether it's a single room refresh or a full house makeover, our work is neat, professional, and long-lasting.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weatherproof your home with durable exterior paint and render. We prepare surfaces properly and use top-grade paint to protect your property from Leeds weather for years to come.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Create impact with wallpaper. We hang traditional wallpaper and install feature walls that match your style perfectly. No bubbles, no joins — just professional results.

services.title: Woodwork & Trim Painting
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, and window frames deserve attention. We prepare and paint all woodwork with a smooth, hard-wearing finish.

services.title: Furniture Upcycling & Spray Painting
services.desc: Bring old furniture back to life with spray paint and bespoke finishes. Ideal for kitchen cabinets, bedroom suites, and decorative pieces.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: We paint shops, offices, and commercial properties. We work efficiently to minimise disruption and keep your business on schedule.

about_pullquote: I paint homes the way I'd paint my own — with care, attention, and no cutting corners.
about_para_1: Alex started painting and decorating across Leeds over 15 years ago. What began as a one-man operation has grown through word-of-mouth reputation and a genuine commitment to getting the job right. Every project, from a bedroom refresh to a full external renovation, receives the same level of care and professionalism.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen, we deliver on time, and our finish is spotless. We're not the cheapest, but we're fair, reliable, and proud of every home we touch. Based in Farnley, we know Leeds well — and we respect the neighbourhoods we work in.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Alex

reviews.text: Alex came and quoted for our whole house interior. Turned up when he said he would, did the job brilliantly, and the finish was immaculate. No mess, no fuss, just a professional painter who clearly cares about his work. Can't recommend him highly enough.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had our kitchen cupboards sprayed and repainted the downstairs cloakroom. Bit nervous about the colour choice, but Alex talked me through it and it looks stunning. He's tidy, efficient, and left the place spotless. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Catherine L.

reviews.text: Got a free quote, no pressure at all. Alex came back with a sensible price and got the work done in two days. Our living room looks completely different. Really pleased and would absolutely have him back.
reviews.author: James P.
